title: ValuesDAO
tagline: ValuesDAO is a composable web3 social profile. ValuesDAO is a data layer for deep human data like Values and Beliefs.
description:
Our AI model helps web3 users make their values tangible.

- Login with Warpcast / Privy
- Generate your Values with AI
- Connect your Twitter, generate values
- Mint them on Base Mainnet

How we mint values?
Currently, we have three ways of generating your values. We aggregate them weight-wise to know which values you hold dearest.

AI Generation: For keep the first version of our product least effort, we have made a simple AI engine that takes your tweets / casts and generates your values
Community Mints: One of the most important indication of my values are the communities i hang out in. In the future, all communities will define their values. We help you claim these values. If you hold a community token/NFT, you can mint the values of that community
Manual Minting: Manual minting is the simplest way to communicate what you stand for. You just type out your values and press mint
